findings.evidence:
wave-B-transaction-id-coverage.json: api_payment_confirm_ok=0 (35/35 orders 422'd) with body 'FCM send failed — will retry'; YET db_with_transaction_id=35 (every order's payment_status=PAID + transaction_id persisted). 12-B-kiosk-mid-rush-after-25.network.json shows 25 POSTs to /api/frontend/order/{id}/payment-confirm all status=422 (orders 629-653); state 12 DOM contains exactly one toast surface '
' which is EMPTY despite the 25 silent failures. State 13 (5× 429 + 5× 422) and state 14 (4× 422) reproduce the same empty kiosk-toast-container. The kiosk client receives 422 'payment failed' for transactions that were ACTUALLY committed in the DB to PAID — a paying customer would see no error AND no confirmation, while the receipt + fiscal sequence are persisted server-side. This conflates payment success with notification dispatch and is production-breaking for kiosk UX + customer trust.
findings.fix_hint: app/Http/Controllers/Frontend/OrderController.php:253-273 — the outer try/catch (Exception) at line 271 swallows the SendFcmNotificationJob RuntimeException ('FCM send failed — will retry' from app/Jobs/SendFcmNotificationJob.php:98) into a generic 422. Wrap the FCM-dispatching call inside finalizePaidKioskOrder() (and any downstream notification side-effects) in a dedicated try/catch that LOGS but DOES NOT bubble — payment-confirm must return 200 once payment_status=PAID + transaction_id are committed (lines 215-220). Note: QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync in this env makes the bubble visible; production async queue would hide the symptom but the SAME defect exists if any synchronous side-effect (audit log, broadcast, observer) throws — the contract that payment-confirm 200 == DB committed must not be coupled to notification health.

findings.evidence: States 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 11 are visually IDENTICAL — all show the kiosk wizard frozen at step 1 'QUELLE VIANDE ?' with viande counter '0/1', SUIVANT button disabled. Spec test-e2e-rush-hour-50x50-2026-05-10-wave-B.spec.js:546 selects '.kiosk-wizard [role="radio"], .kiosk-wizard [role="button"]' to advance the wizard, but the viande cards in the actual DOM use 'role="group"' (08-B dom.html: '<div ... class="kiosk-viande-card is-selectable" role="group" tabindex="0" aria-label="Merguez, 0">'). The selector matches nothing → click silently no-ops → counter stays at 0/1 → SUIVANT stays disabled → wizard never advances. Cascading audit-integrity consequences: state 11 'kiosk-confirmation' PNG shows the SAME viande step (no confirmation ever rendered); state 14 'kiosk-final-confirmation' shows 'BURGER POULET' wizard frozen at QUELLE SAUCE step 1 (same selector defect on burger flow). Mislabeled artifacts mislead future reviewers into thinking the kiosk UI flow was exercised when it never advanced past step 1.
findings.fix_hint: tests/e2e/test-e2e-rush-hour-50x50-2026-05-10-wave-B.spec.js:546, 566, 583 — replace selector with '.kiosk-wizard .kiosk-viande-card.is-selectable, .kiosk-wizard .kiosk-sauce-card, .kiosk-wizard [data-testid^="kiosk-viande-card-"]' or directly target by role=group + aria-label. Verify by re-running and asserting '.kiosk-counter-badge' text changes to '1/1' before clicking '.kiosk-btn-next'. Round-2 spec rev should ALSO rename PNGs that don't match their content (states 11/14) or insert assertions that fail loudly when the wizard didn't advance.

findings.evidence: wave-B-timing-kds-arrival.json is empty: {"samples":[], "p95_ms":null, "count":0}. The agent reported 'TIMING-B4: chefPage.request.get(/api/admin/kds-order) returned non-ok... 0 samples' and concluded '0 of this run's orders cross-surface'. CONTRADICTED by direct visual inspection: 16-B-kds-pile-from-B.dom.html contains all 35 Wave B orders (grep 'AUDIT-KIOSK-WAVE-E' = 35 matches; queue numbers A0142–A0176 enumerated; PNG visibly shows orders #100526666/A0176 + #100526665/A0175 in 'À emporter' column with 'Confirmées' badge). Cross-surface integrity is in fact INTACT, but the agent's API-probe assertion was vacuous AND the agent then drew the wrong conclusion that orders never reached KDS — a P1 audit_integrity defect that, if uncorrected, would have generated a false P0 cross-surface alarm in their report.
findings.fix_hint: tests/e2e/test-e2e-rush-hour-50x50-2026-05-10-wave-B.spec.js:773 — chefPage.request.get('/api/admin/kds-order') likely fails because Playwright APIRequestContext doesn't share session cookies with the browser context by default for this Spatie permission-gated endpoint. Either (a) re-mint via chefPage.context().request and pass storageState, OR (b) replace the API probe with a DOM probe: chefPage.locator('[data-testid^="kds-card-"]').filter({ hasText: 'AUDIT-KIOSK-WAVE-E' }).count() and timestamp the first appearance via MutationObserver. Either approach gets real timing samples instead of an empty grid.

findings.evidence: State 12 console.json contains 25 application-source 'Failed to load resource: status of 422 (Unprocessable Content)' errors NOT covered by allowlist (the allowlist permits 422 on form validation; these are POST /api/frontend/order/{id}/payment-confirm responses for committed payments — see B-001). State 13 contains 5× 429 (allowlisted as expected rate-limit-bucket behavior per spec docstring) BUT ALSO 7× 422 from the same payment-confirm bubble. State 14 contains 1× 422 from same source. Total non-allowlisted application errors across the rush: 33+ console errors all surfacing the same root cause (B-001). Filed separately because reviewer protocol §category 9 requires console_error report whenever non-vendor errors persist; closure is gated by B-001 fix.
findings.fix_hint: Closes when B-001 closes — same root cause. Add a vitest assertion that /payment-confirm returns 200 when payment_status=PAID is committed, regardless of FCM availability.

findings.evidence: 16-B-kds-pile-from-B.dom.html includes a salmon-colored top banner: 'Liste pleine (50 affichée(s), max. serveur) : d'autres commandes actives existent peut-être — filtrez par statut ou cherchez un n° de ticket. Voir plus'. Visible in PNG. Behavior: KDS hard-caps the visible pile at 50 active orders. With 50 orders/wave and any ambient orders, chefs would silently miss orders past the cap. NOT P1 because (a) the warning IS shown (not a silent failure), (b) the cap of 50 is a known product setting and reviewer protocol cannot rule out test-environment artifact (ambient + Wave B = 50+), and (c) 'Voir plus' link offers escape. Conservative P2 — flag for product/UX consideration: at peak rush, 50 concurrent orders is plausible in real fast-food ops; chefs need confidence the banner is informational, not a defect.
findings.fix_hint: Either (a) raise the cap based on tenant size config, (b) make 'Voir plus' inline-expand instead of navigating, or (c) replace 'Liste pleine' wording with 'Plus de 50 commandes actives — Voir toutes' to remove 'max. serveur' confusion (chefs may interpret 'max. serveur' as a server crash). Investigate KDS query in app/Http/Controllers/Admin/KdsOrderController.php for the 50 limit.

findings.evidence: placeKioskOrder helper at kiosk-order.js:384 hardcodes 'const orderToken = `${KIOSK_AUDIT_PREFIX}-${runStamp}`' (KIOSK_AUDIT_PREFIX='AUDIT-KIOSK-WAVE-E') with NO override path that reads options.orderToken passed by the caller. Wave B spec passes 'AUDIT-RUSH-B-{seq}-{ts}' in the items[*].instruction (preserved) AND in the helper-call orderToken option (silently ignored). Result: every Wave B order's DB token is 'AUDIT-KIOSK-WAVE-E-…' — visible in wave-B-numeric-grid.json: 'token': 'AUDIT-KIOSK-WAVE-E-1778444715918-100683'. Cleanup still works (TOKEN_PATTERNS includes 'AUDIT-%') but cross-wave attribution by token is impossible. Helper docstring (per agent's report) references override logic that doesn't exist in the function body. Test infra debt, not product.
findings.fix_hint: tests/e2e/helpers/kiosk-order.js:384 — replace with 'const orderToken = options.orderToken || `${KIOSK_AUDIT_PREFIX}-${runStamp}`' (assuming options is the existing params object). Update docstring to match. Add a unit assertion on the helper that confirms the override is honored.
